findings.correction: I’ll become stronger. As strong as Jopil. No—far stronger than Jopil.
findings.current: I’ll become stronger. As strong as Jopil. No—as strong as or stronger than Jopil.
findings.defect: The self-correction 훨씬 (‘far more’) is reduced to a hedge, ‘as strong as or stronger.’
findings.rationale: 한엽 first matches Jopil, then raises the target well beyond him; the draft’s ‘or stronger’ undoes that escalation.
findings.source: 강해질 겁니다. 조필만큼. 아니, 조필보다 훨씬.

findings.defect: 더 marks a comparative ‘even more,’ not additive ‘also/too.’
findings.rationale: After 한엽’s vow, 혁무진 answers with 더, a competitive raise, not 나도.

findings.correction: Even the timid Second Rate martial artist had, before anyone noticed, joined that current.
findings.current: Even the timid Second Rate martial artist had been swept up in the current.
findings.defect: 동참했다 is active joining; ‘swept up’ makes 한엽 a passive object of the current.
findings.rationale: 어느새 동참했다 is his participation in the changed flow, matching the ‘this guy changed too’ beat.
findings.source: 소심하던 이류 무사도 어느새 그 흐름에 동참했다.

findings.correction: I’d stood there quietly listening to see what they were saying, and it was quite a scene—a real spectacle.
findings.current: I’d stood there listening to them for a while, and it had been absolutely unbearable.
findings.defect: 가관이다 is a derisive ‘what a spectacle,’ not endurance-breaking ‘unbearable.’
findings.rationale: The gag is secondhand cringe at the earnest talk, not that he could not bear to hear it.
findings.source: 무슨 얘길 하나 가만히 듣고 있었는데 아주 가관이다, 가관.

findings.correction: Still, I have to admit it’s kind of admirable.
findings.current: Still, I have to admit it’s kind of touching.
findings.defect: 기특하다 is patronizing approval (‘good for them’), not sentimental ‘touching.’
findings.rationale: 진태경’s beat is grudging pride in subordinates, then 정나미; ‘touching’ shifts him into softness the source withholds until the next lines.

findings.correction: Gambling my life for a mere NPC in a game.
findings.current: I had risked my life for a couple of NPCs in a game.
findings.defect: NPC is singular (공야청) with 고작; 목숨을 건 도박 is a life-stakes gamble, and ‘a couple’ invents a count.
findings.rationale: The self-reproach is the insane bet for one game NPC; plurality and loss of 도박 change the causal self-explanation.
findings.source: 고작 게임 속 NPC를 위해서 목숨을 건 도박을 하다니.

findings.correction: To someone in Murim, the value of these things was beyond any golden calf.
findings.current: To a martial artist, the value of these things couldn’t be compared to a golden calf.
findings.defect: 무림인 is a Murim person; the bound term 무림 is dropped.
findings.rationale: Glossary maps 무림 to Murim; ‘martial artist’ is generic and loses the setting term present in the source.
findings.source: 무림인에게 이 물건들의 가치는 금송아지에 비할 바가 아니다.

findings.correction: Keep the scene as dash/Sound Transmission lines, not spoken quotes: — The moon is very bright. — So it is.
findings.defect: The garden exchange is dash-marked throughout, unlike quoted speech in the rest of the chapter; regular quotes make it ordinary audible talk.
findings.rationale: The source isolates this meeting from voiced dialogue; quoting it in a moonlit garden implies they are speaking aloud.

findings.correction: Behind the two men, lost in thought, the door that had been slightly ajar slid shut.
findings.current: The door that had been left slightly open behind the two men slid shut.
findings.defect: Omits 생각에 잠긴, the cue that they are too absorbed to notice the door.
findings.rationale: Their absorption explains why the eavesdropper can close the door unseen.
findings.source: 생각에 잠긴 두 사람의 등 뒤로 빠끔히 열려 있던 문이 스르륵 닫혔다.

findings.defect: 씨 is milder than fuck; the chapter’s strong curse is the later 시바.
findings.rationale: Profanity should not be stepped up; 어후, 씨 is exasperated and light next to 시바.

findings.defect: Bound rendering of 습득 is Acquired, not the imperative Acquire.
findings.rationale: The glossary maps 습득 to Acquired for System/UI wording.

summary: Major fidelity misses: Han Yeop’s ‘far stronger than Jopil’ correction is hedged; Hyuk’s 더 is rendered as ‘too’; 가관/기특/동참 shift humor, attitude, and agency; NPC quantity and the life-gamble are altered; 무림인 drops Murim; garden dash-speech is recast as ordinary dialogue.
